description: Minas Água is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Arquivos contendo a rede hidrográfica da RHII e entorno utilizados durante o projeto. Arquivo vetorial contendo a localização das minas d'água. Metadados administrados pela Gerência de Gestão do Território e Informações Geoespaciais (GEGET), setor pertencente à Diretoria de Biodiversidade e Áreas Protegidas e Ecossistemas - DIBAPE. Consulte também:. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
